title.narrative: Water, Land, and Roads Investment Program - Year 1

description.narrative: The Welfare Association (Taawon), a leading development organization in Palestine, in partnership with the Land Research Center (LRC), and the Palestinian Hydrological Group (PHG), is leading and implementing the Water, Land, and Agricultural Roads Investment Program funded by the Dutch Representative Office (NRO) in Ramallah. The overall goal of the program is to achieve “increased resilience, resource use efficiency, sustainable food production and productivity for Palestinian agricultural producers and their organizations,” and the purpose of the program is “sustainable access to water and land productivity, enhancing farm household income, advanced capabilities, and agricultural and climate practices for small farming families, agricultural producers and their organizations in the targeted locations in the West Bank.

title.narrative: Outcome 3: Enhanced inclusive access to, effective and efficient use of farmland by farmers & communities.

description.narrative: Achieving enhanced inclusive access to and effective utilization of farmland by farmers and communities. This outcome strives to create an environment where farmers and local communities have improved and equitable access to farmland. The emphasis is not only on accessibility but also on ensuring that the use of farmland is both efficient and effective. By achieving this outcome, the goal is to empower farmers and communities, promoting sustainable and productive agricultural practices while fostering inclusivity and shared benefits.
